text: 日前，知名经济学家刘煜辉在宁波银行年中投策会上表示，7月，全球资产经历了一轮陡峭的高波动。这轮波动受地缘、货币金融周期和AI自身的产业周期三个因素影响。在他的框架里，短期的重心在货币金融周期，只要10年期美债利率还处于4.7%降不下来，波动就远没有结束。产业维度上，他判断美国AI正进入三道坎的中考：生产者剩余与消费者剩余的极致失衡，AI生产力与传统生产关系的颠覆性冲突，以及来自中国超级工程优化能力的“推倒壁垒”。 刘煜辉表示，算力和Token正在快速基础设施化，而“AI产业中间挖到金子的人，一定是在白菜价的算力之上创造出杀手级应用的那批人”。对于AI科创
text_en: Recently, well-known economist Liu Yuhui said at Bank of Ningbo's mid-year investment strategy meeting that global assets experienced a steep bout of high volatility in July, driven by three factors: geopolitics, the monetary-financial cycle, and AI's own industrial cycle. In his framework, the short-term focus is the monetary-financial cycle—as long as the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield stays stuck above 4.7%, the volatility is far from over. On the industrial side, he judges U.S. AI is entering the mid-term test of three hurdles: an extreme imbalance between producer surplus and consumer surplus, a disruptive conflict between AI productivity and traditional production relations, and China's 'wall-breaking' ability from super-engineering optimization. Liu said computing power and tokens are rapidly becoming infrastructure, and 'those who strike gold in the AI industry will be the ones creating killer apps on top of dirt-cheap computing power.'
